svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: Route 53 -> NLB -> Traefik -> 9 Go services -> SNS + SQS | scaled by KEDA and Karpenter | delivered by Argo CD
VPC - public and private subnets across 3 availability zones
Amazon EKS cluster - private subnets - system nodes on-demand, workload nodes Spot
HPA on HTTP, KEDA on consumers
Platform controllers - every one installed by Argo CD from the GitOps repo
signed images, tagged by commit SHA
one role per service account, no stored keys
test, scan, build, sign, push to ECR
